description: M0 controlled arm (v1 spec §12). Each case pins an EXACT version in the prompt and asks for code using that package. A referenced symbol absent from the pinned version's tier-A surface is a miss. Mixes packages whose surface moved across majors (uuid, chalk, commander) with stable controls (semver, ms) so the number is not an artifact of only picking churn.
